NE555: pins 8 and 4 to supply, 1 to ground; RA from supply to pins 6 and 7; capacitor from pins 6 and 7 to ground; trigger pin 2 pulsed low, output pin 3. Pin 5 bypass to ground.
NE555: pins 8 and 4 to supply, 1 to ground. RA supply to pin 7; RB pin 7 to joined pins 2 and 6; timing capacitor to ground; output pin 3; pin 5 bypass capacitor to ground.
Star: three resistors meet at a common centre. Delta: three resistors form the sides of a triangle between A, B and C.

Electro

An original electrical and electronics engineering workbench with elevator and escalator references, exact supplied fault records, component and controller-terminal identification, original interactive drawings and engineering calculators. All runtime content is bundled and available offline. No advertising, account or network permission.

Reference values are educational aids. Check exact component datasheets and installation standards for your design.

Designed and authored for Electro.

Material Icons — Google (Apache 2.0).
JUnit 4 — EPL 1.0.

Component names identify manufacturers’ parts and remain their respective owners’ marks. Dataset descriptions, circuit motifs and connector drawings are original. Reference URLs are listed on relevant pages and in SOURCES.md; browsing is not required by the app.
